favourite.heading: Why Massachusetts can pull away
bullets: Playing at Massachusetts is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

Massachusetts is the better football team by 1.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+1.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Eastern Michigan can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.1 points wide at one sigma — p10 -17.7 to p90 +26.3 for Massachusetts, so a projection of +5.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 3%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
